name: Bauernhof Wimmerhof
beschreibung: The Bauernhof Wimmerhof in Ebbs is a working agricultural farm operated as a traditional country inn. Guests can choose from a range of welcoming accommodation options. The farm's own agricultural produce supplies the kitchen with fresh ingredients, ensuring authentic Tyrolean dining. The rooms are neat, practical, and well-maintained. Situated in the picturesque village of Ebbs, the inn serves as an excellent base for scenic excursions into the nearby Kaisergebirge mountains.
